title: Horizon Summit returns to Austin for 2027
summary: Three days, five tracks and a new home at Mueller Commons. Here is what is changing for 2027.
content:
Horizon Summit is back in Austin, Texas, April 13–15, 2027. After two sold-out years downtown, we are moving to Mueller Commons, which gives us a proper main stage, two breakout halls, a dedicated workshop lab and a lot more natural light.

The program grows to five tracks: AI & Data, Platform & Cloud, Product & Design, Security & Trust, and Leadership & Culture.

title: First speakers announced: Maya Okafor, Daniel Reyes and more
summary: Our first wave of speakers covers production AI, the world's most boring control plane and design systems that survive rebrands.
content:
We are excited to announce the first wave of Horizon Summit 2027 speakers, including Maya Okafor (Lumenstack), Daniel Reyes (Nimbus Forge), Priya Raman (Quillmetric) and Lukas Brandt (Arcadia Labs).

Browse the full speaker directory.
